content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fredericksburg

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Review PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Fredericksburg professionals in defense contracting, federal agencies, and software development typically meet these standards. Verify your qualifications before enrolling to ensure a smooth application process.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our interactive sessions fit working schedules and deliver comprehensive coverage of the PMBOK Guide and exam domains. You'll earn the formal education hours PMI requires to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the boot camp, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the exam fee. Our team guides you through documentation and submission to avoid delays. PMI will review your credentials before you're eligible to test.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and instructor support to build confidence. Schedule your proctored PMP exam when ready. Our boot camp alumni receive ongoing access to study materials and Q&A support before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout the three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses and resources aligned with PMI standards. Plan ahead to complete renewal requirements before your certification expires.
